value.description: The value associated with this pivot item. Used to identify the item within a group. Set a unique value for each item in a group to track selection state.

selected.description: Whether this item is currently selected. Only one item should be selected in a group. When true, the item is visually highlighted and does not emit the selected event on click.

direction.description: Layout direction for the item: horizontal (default) or vertical. Should match the direction of the containing group. Use horizontal for row/tab layouts and vertical for column/rail layouts.

hasLeadingIcon.description: Whether to display a leading icon. If true, renders the icon slot. Place an icon element (e.g., <obi-home slot="icon"></obi-home>) in the slot to show an icon.

hasLabel.description: Whether to display a text label. If true and label is non-empty, shows the label. Use in combination with hasLeadingIcon for icon+label layouts.

label.description: The text label to display for the item. Only shown if hasLabel is true and label is non-empty. Keep labels concise for best appearance, especially in horizontal layouts.

disabled.description: Disables the item, preventing interaction and applying a disabled style. When true, the item cannot be selected and is visually muted.

iconName.description: The icon in the `icon` slot, by name (an OpenBridge icon the module bundles); empty puts none. Leading icon slot (shown when hasLeadingIcon is true)

componentSize.description: OpenBridge component size: regular, medium, large or xl.
